summary: A is materially closer to the frozen contract, chiefly because it implements the exact required Upload signature and retains FilesOption. Neither patch is merge-ready: both bypass FilesService.Add, add forbidden association machinery, modify unrelated retry behavior, and omit a source-reader-error test.
reasons: A implements Upload(ctx, fileName, content, opts ...FilesOption) exactly; B substitutes ...UploadFileOption, directly violating the required public API.
A adds one unnecessary FilesOption extension, whereas B introduces a parallel option hierarchy, changes existing option constructor return types, and adds numerous prohibited association APIs.
A validates filename and content separately and tests both cases; B combines their error semantics.

Both propagate multipart encoding errors, but neither visibly tests a failing source reader as required by the contract. B has the stronger Upload retry test because it supplies an os.File and compares both encoded attempts, but that does not outweigh its API incompatibility and larger scope violation.
risks_a: Upload calls Raw.Do and duplicates Add's option, request, response, and error handling instead of routing through FilesService.Add.
It calls a new NewFileWithFields helper and adds WithFilesFormFields despite explicit requirements to reuse NewFile and not add association fields.

It changes global raw request replay and reader-closing semantics, outside the requested scope and contrary to the instruction not to refactor retry machinery; its SeekEnd failure path may leave the initial reader position uncertain while still enabling replay.
risks_b: Upload has the wrong variadic option type and therefore does not provide the exact contracted API.
It adds many association functions and a parallel UploadFileOption/FilesRequestOption system explicitly excluded by the contract.
Like A, it bypasses FilesService.Add and expands internal multipart machinery instead of using NewFile directly as required; it also changes global retry and body-ownership behavior beyond scope.
